problem.read: The server didn't answer as expected. Try again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not see or do this.
problem.offline: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
problem.gone: It no longer exists, or it belongs to another company.
problem.write: It was not saved. Try again.
problem.changed: Someone changed the order meanwhile: it was read again. Check and try again.
problem.invalid: Something in it was not accepted. Check the fields and try again.
problem.slowDown: Too many tries at once. Wait a moment and try again.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.body: This subcontract order does not exist, or it belongs to another company.

forbidden.title: Not for your role
forbidden.body: Your role does not reach this order’s company, site or workshop.

noAccess.title: Not for your role
noAccess.body: Subcontract orders need purchasing.view: ask an administrator for it.

record.changed: Changed at {time} by someone else · your open dialog is kept
record.readOnly: You read this order: changing it, sending its kit or receiving goods back need another role.
record.noPanels: The thread, files and history appear here.

band.title: Subcontract order
band.dockHint: The thread beside any tab on a wide screen (⌘J)
band.noDdt: No live kit DDT yet: it is issued when the kit is sent.

waits.draft: A draft: the buyer sets the operations, pieces, fee and return date, then sends it to the workshop.
waits.kit: Sent to {workshop}: the warehouse sends the kit and the pieces with the DDT.
waits.close: Every piece is back: close the order.

notice.issued: Sent to the workshop: the warehouse can send the kit now.
notice.reopened: Back to draft: change it and send it again.
notice.cancelled: The order is cancelled; its planned kit lines too.
notice.kitPlanned: The kit is planned from the work order’s materials.
notice.lineReturned: The line is back in our stock and planned again.
notice.printed: The DDT’s PDF is printed again.
notice.annulled: DDT {number} is annulled: its number stays.

ops.draftHint: A draft: each field saves when you leave it (Enter or Tab); Esc puts the saved value back.
ops.frozen: Changes to the operations are made only while the order is a draft; the counts move with the kit and the goods back.
ops.frozenReopen: Changes are made only while the order is a draft: nothing is out yet, so ⋯ Back to draft opens it again.

empty.title: No operations
empty.body: Pick them from the work order’s routing.

cell.piecesRange: more pieces than the work order makes
cell.piecesTaken: some pieces are on another live order
cell.feeNumber: a fee of 0 or more, up to six decimals
cell.dateBefore: due back on or after the order date
cell.sizesAddUp: the pieces per size must add up: change them in Pieces per size
cell.notDraft: the order is no longer a draft

kit.lotAtSend: Lot picked when it is sent
kit.notSelectableSent: Already sent: take it back from its row menu if it never left.

empty.title: Kit not sent yet
empty.body: No kit line yet: the buyer plans it from the work order’s materials, or the pieces go alone.
empty.bodyEdit: Plan it from the work order’s materials, or add the lines one by one. Leather tracked by the hide goes cut, as bundles.

kit.floorLater: Here the office sends the kit with its DDT; sending it from the warehouse tablet (Subcontract kits) comes with a later step.

ddts.title: Kit DDTs (work on our behalf)
ddts.none: No DDT issued for this order yet.

kitLine.title: Add kit line
kitLine.hideNote: Leather tracked by the hide goes cut, as bundles: name the hide when the line is sent.

held.quantity: A quantity above 0, up to four decimals.

back.summary: Back good {good} · defective {defective} · scrapped {scrapped} · still at the workshop {out}

empty.title: Nothing back yet
empty.body: Goods come back by operation and bundle: good, defective or scrapped at the workshop, with the unused material.

back.qualityLater: The quality inspection of what came back is not linked from here yet.

jobSheet.name: Job sheet {number}
jobSheet.status: Printed and sent with the kit; no price on it. It opens in a new tab: print it, or save it as a PDF.

docs.noDdt: No kit DDT yet: it is issued when the kit is sent.

pdf.missing: The DDT is issued but its PDF was not stored: print it again.

docs.later: The workshop’s written terms and its invoices come with later steps.

cancel.title: Cancel {number}
cancel.what: {workshop} gets no work from it; nothing has gone out.
cancel.pieces: Its pieces of {number} are free again for another order.
cancel.final: A cancelled order cannot be opened again.
cancel.reasonHint: Kept on the order and in its history.
cancel.kit_one: Its {count} planned kit line is cancelled too.
cancel.kit_other: Its {count} planned kit lines are cancelled too.

close.title: Close {number}
close.back: Back: {good} good, {defective} defective, {scrapped} scrapped at the workshop.
close.balanceLater: The material balance (sent, in the garments, returned, still out) comes with a later step: check the stock at the workshop first.
close.final: A closed order takes nothing more.
close.noteHint: Optional; kept in the order’s history.

addOperation.title: Add operation
addOperation.body: The operations of work order {number} not on this order yet.
addOperation.none: Every operation of the work order is on this order already.
addOperation.full: Every piece is on live orders already.
addOperation.piecesHint: Every size gets its share when all pieces go; fewer pieces: split them per size afterwards.

held.failed: The work order could not be read.
held.already: This operation is on the order already.

refused.pieces: Some pieces are on another live order: lower the pieces.
refused.operation: That operation is not of the work order any more.

removeOperation.title: Remove line {line}
removeOperation.body_one: {code} {name} with its {count} piece leaves the order.
removeOperation.body_other: {code} {name} with its {count} pieces leaves the order.

sizes.title: Pieces per size, line {line}
sizes.body: The cells of work order {number}: each takes at most the garments it makes.
sizes.caption: Pieces sent per colour and size

held.failed: The work order’s sizes could not be read.

returnLine.title: Take back kit line {seq}
returnLine.what: {code} {name} never left: it goes back where it came from.
returnLine.reverse: Its move into the workshop’s place is reversed and the line is planned again.
returnLine.ddtFirst: DDT {number} is live for it: annul the DDT in Documents first.

held.ddtLive: DDT {number} is live: the goods travelled with it. Annul it in Documents first.

refused.ddtLive: Its DDT is live: annul it in Documents first, then take the line back.

annul.title: Annul DDT {number}
annul.keeps: {number} keeps its number, marked annulled, for 10 years.
annul.lines: Its kit lines stay sent: take back the ones that never left from the Kit tab.
annul.replace: Goods that travel still need a new DDT: send the kit again with one.
annul.typeWrong: Does not match the DDT number.

held.phrase: Type the DDT number to confirm.

send.title: Send kit · {number} to {workshop}
send.body: Our material moves to {location}: it stays ours, in our books, until it comes back in the garments.
send.noKit: No planned kit line: only pieces and bundles go now.
send.fromLot: A tracked material leaves by its released lot.
send.noStock: Nothing of it is available on this site: receive it or move it here first.
send.noPieces: Every piece has gone out already.
send.piecesLeft: {left} of {total} still to send; 0: none now
send.bundlesNoRight: The work order’s bundles need workorders.view: type the pieces above.
send.noBundles: The work order has no active bundle.
send.bundlesHint: Each bundle is listed on the DDT; with no pieces typed above, the whole-garment bundles count as the pieces sent.
send.ddtTitle: DDT for work on our behalf
send.ddtNoRight: Issuing the DDT needs shipping.ddt.issue: the kit goes without one and the warehouse issues it later.
send.ddtLater: No DDT now: issue it before the goods leave the building.

ddt.fixed: The number comes from the series and is kept 10 years; the DDT never changes after this (a mistake is annulled).

held.loading: Still reading where the material is…
held.sourcesFailed: Where the material is could not be read: try again.
held.from: Line {line}: pick where it leaves from.
held.piecesLeft: Line {line}: at most {left} pieces are still to send.
held.nothing: Nothing is picked: a kit line, pieces or a bundle.

refused.ddtRight: Your role may send the kit but not issue the DDT: send it without one.
refused.lot: A tracked material needs its lot: pick where it leaves from again.
refused.lotNotReleased: Only a released lot goes to a workshop: pick another place or lot.
refused.hide: A material tracked by the hide needs its hide.
refused.from: That place is not of this site, or holds none of it now.
refused.quantity: A quantity was not accepted: check the units.
refused.pieces: More pieces than are still to send.
refused.bundles: A bundle is not of this work order or of a size this order sends.
refused.tooManyBundles: Too many lines for one DDT: send the bundles in two goes.
refused.weight: The weight was not accepted: kilograms, up to three decimals.
refused.startAt: The transport’s start is not accepted.
refused.company: The company’s legal details for the DDT are incomplete: complete them in Admin › Companies & sites.
refused.recipient: The workshop has no address for the DDT: add it to the workshop.
refused.stock: Not enough of it at that place any more: pick again.

done.pdfMissing: Kit sent with DDT {number}: the DDT is issued but its PDF was not stored — print it again in Documents.
done.noDdt: Kit sent without a DDT: issue it before the goods leave the building.

receive.title: Receive back · {number} from {workshop}
receive.ddtHint: As printed on its delivery note.
receive.nothingOut: No piece is at the workshop: only unused material can come back.
receive.bundlesNoRight: Bundles need workorders.view: the pieces come back by operation.
receive.noStock: None of our material is at this workshop.
receive.what: The order is partly back or back; the pieces back count on each operation.
receive.fee: The workshop’s fee for the pieces back good goes on the work order’s cost.

held.reason: Line {line}: say why pieces are defective or scrapped.
held.moreThanOut: Line {line}: only {out} pieces are at the workshop.
held.returnMore: {item}: at most {max} is at the workshop.
held.nothing: Nothing is back yet: a piece or some material.
held.ddtNumber: Type the number of the workshop’s DDT, or clear its date.

refused.bundle: A bundle is not of a size this operation sends, or comes back more than it holds.
refused.moreThanOut: More pieces than are at the workshop.
refused.pieces: At least one piece per line, whole pieces only.
refused.toLocation: That place is not of this site.
refused.returns: A returned material was not accepted: check its quantity.
refused.receivedAt: The date it came back is not accepted.
refused.stock: Less of it is at the workshop than you returned.

done.part: Recorded: the order is partly back.
done.all: Recorded: every piece is back. Close the order.
done.partWaiting: Recorded: partly back. The workshop’s fee waits for the work order’s cost to be ready.
done.allWaiting: Recorded: every piece is back. The workshop’s fee waits for the work order’s cost to be ready.
done.partCurrency: Recorded: partly back. The order is in another currency: its fee is not booked to the work order.
done.allCurrency: Recorded: every piece is back. The order is in another currency: its fee is not booked to the work order.
done.partPosted_one: Recorded: partly back. The fee went on the work order’s cost ({count} entry).
done.partPosted_other: Recorded: partly back. The fee went on the work order’s cost ({count} entries).
done.allPosted_one: Recorded: every piece is back; the fee went on the work order’s cost ({count} entry). Close the order.
done.allPosted_other: Recorded: every piece is back; the fee went on the work order’s cost ({count} entries). Close the order.

sheet.title: Job sheet {number} · {workshop}
sheet.purpose: Printed and sent with the kit. It carries no price.
sheet.noKit: No kit: the pieces travel alone.
sheet.ours: The material sent stays ours: return what is not used with the garments.
